# Doc Structure Collector Prompt

Use this prompt to generate or update documentation that reflects the current .github folder structure and its contents.

---

**Prompt:**

Scan the entire .github directory and its subfolders. List all files and folders, summarize their purpose (if possible), and generate a Markdown section that can be appended to README.md and copilot-instructions.md. Ensure the output is clear, up-to-date, and useful for developers and contributors.
